name: js-debug-dap
notes: Pinned 2026-08-29 (NODEDEBUG G2; the latest vscode-js-debug release at pin time). js-debug (Microsoft, MIT) — the standalone DAP server for Node/TypeScript debugging; a MULTI-SESSION adapter (per-target children via startDebugging — dapClient's child-session road drives it). Pure JS under Mercury's node prerequisite. Invocation: `node <vendor-root>/src/dapDebugServer.js <port> 127.0.0.1`. The GitHub release tarball roots everything under js-debug/ (stripped on extraction — the npm package/ idiom). Update procedure: bump version/url from the vscode-js-debug releases page, recompute sha512 from the downloaded asset (shasum -a 512), run `bun run scripts/vendor/fetch-js-debug.ts`, rebuild, re-run `bash scripts/dap/run-all.sh`.
